title: Property Charges and Tax Rates Contracted by Hotel Rate Plan
content:
The mandatory property charges and the statutory rates carried by each plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range are set out below.

| Rate plan | Property facility fee, per room per night | Facility fee waived | Occupancy tax | City tax | Parking, per room per night | In-room internet in the rate | Internet, per day |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 39.00 USD | no | 12.5 percent | 4 percent | 42.00 USD | no | 14.95 USD |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 39.00 USD | no | 12.5 percent | 4 percent | 42.00 USD | yes | 0.00 USD |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 35.00 USD | no | 12.5 percent | 4 percent | 38.00 USD | yes | 0.00 USD |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 35.00 USD | no | 12.5 percent | 4 percent | 35.00 USD | yes | 0.00 USD |
| Member Flex Rate | 29.00 USD | no | 12.5 percent | 4 percent | 28.00 USD | yes | 0.00 USD |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 45.00 USD | no | 12.5 percent | 4 percent | 35.00 USD | yes | 0.00 USD |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 0.00 USD | yes | 12.5 percent | 4 percent | 0.00 USD | yes | 0.00 USD |

The facility fee is the mandatory property facility fee charged per room per night, and the column beside it records whether the plan waives it. The occupancy tax is the state or provincial occupancy tax applied to the room total as a percentage, and the city tax the city or tourism levy applied on the same basis. The parking figure is the self-parking charge per room per night. The last two columns record whether in-room internet is included in the nightly rate and, where it is not, the charge per day.

*Hypothetical arithmetic.* On the Suite Flexible Rate, whose facility fee is the highest in the range at 45.00 USD, three nights of facility fee come to 135.00 USD. The All-Inclusive Flex Rate is the one plan of the range that waives the facility fee, and its parking figure is likewise 0.00 USD.
